$comment: Settings contract: keys, types, defaults, labels, descriptions, and CSS-var bindings. Read by Rust (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/config.rs) via include_str! and by the frontend via a static import (lib/settings-schema.ts). Theme preset *values* are not part of the contract — they live in shared/themes/*.json, one file per preset. Per docs/consolidation.md: do not declare defaults, labels, or types anywhere else.

settings.label: Font Size
settings.description: Font size in pixels for the editor

settings.label: Line Height
settings.description: Line height multiplier for the editor

settings.label: Content Width
settings.description: Maximum width of the text column in pixels

settings.label: Tab Size
settings.description: Number of spaces per tab

settings.label: Words
settings.description: Show the word count in the status bar

settings.label: Characters
settings.description: Show the character count in the status bar

settings.label: Paragraphs
settings.description: Show the paragraph count in the status bar

settings.label: Schema
settings.description: Light or dark color schema

settings.label: Sidebar Width
settings.description: Default sidebar width in pixels

settings.label: Sidebar Visible
settings.description: Show the sidebar by default

settings.label: Calendar Visible
settings.description: Show the calendar panel on the right (Cmd+])

settings.label: Sidebar File Label
settings.description: Show the document title or the filename for files in the sidebar

settings.label: Sidebar Search Button
settings.description: Show the Search button at the top of the sidebar

settings.label: Sidebar Recents
settings.description: Show the Recents section in the sidebar

settings.label: Zoom
settings.description: Scale of the whole window, in percent. Cmd+= zooms in, Cmd+- zooms out, Cmd+0 returns to 100.

settings.label: UI font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used throughout the app
settings.default: "SF Pro", -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

settings.label: Editor font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used for document text
settings.default: "SF Pro", -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

settings.label: Code font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used for code
settings.default: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Light theme accent color

settings.label: Background
settings.description: Light theme background color

settings.label: Foreground
settings.description: Light theme foreground color

settings.label: Translucent
settings.description: Light theme translucency (0 = solid, 100 = max).

settings.label: Contrast
settings.description: alpha multiplier on borders, cards, hover bgs.

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Dark theme accent color

settings.label: Background
settings.description: Dark theme background color

settings.label: Foreground
settings.description: Dark theme foreground color

settings.label: Translucent
settings.description: Dark theme translucency (0 = solid, 100 = max).

settings.label: Contrast
settings.description: alpha multiplier on borders, cards, hover bgs.

settings.label: Board Colours
settings.description: Colours offered for shape fills and borders on boards, in order. Edit them from a shape's Fill or Border menu.

settings.label: File Associations
settings.description: File patterns to include in the workspace

settings.label: Default Encoding
settings.description: Default text encoding for files

settings.label: Insert Final Newline
settings.description: Ensure files end with a newline when saving

settings.label: Trim Trailing Whitespace
settings.description: Remove trailing whitespace from lines when saving

settings.label: Restore Open Files
settings.description: Reopen previously open files when opening a workspace

settings.label: Max Recent Workspaces
settings.description: Maximum number of recent workspaces to remember

settings.label: Agent Model
settings.description: The Claude model the Agent chat uses. Haiku answers fastest; Sonnet and Opus think harder but take longer. Type /model in the chat to switch.

settings.label: Daily Note Folder
settings.description: Folder inside the workspace where dated daily notes are created. Leave blank to create them at the workspace root.

settings.label: Default Terminal
settings.description: Terminal application name on macOS, or executable name/full path on Windows and Linux. Leave blank for Pensée's platform default; arguments are not supported.

settings.label: Import Highlights
settings.description: Bring Apple Books highlights and notes into this workspace, one page per book tagged Book. A page that already has the book's name gets the highlights; otherwise a new page is made. Checks again every 10 minutes. macOS may ask to let Pensée access data from other apps.

settings.label: New Book Pages Folder
settings.description: Folder inside the workspace where new book pages are created. Leave blank to create them at the workspace root.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.description: From your app in the X Developer Console (Keys and tokens → OAuth 2.0 Client ID). Set the app's callback URL to http://127.0.0.1:47863/x/callback.

settings.label: Bookmarks Folder
settings.description: Folder inside the workspace where bookmark notes are saved.

settings.label: Restore Workspace
settings.description: Automatically reopen the last workspace when the app starts

settings.label: Search Debounce
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds before performing search

settings.label: Max Search Results
settings.description: Maximum number of search results to return
